items.difficulty_reason: The counted theorem is the author theorem at source lines 749-751: every proof in G3c plus the cut rule can be transformed into a cut-free G3c proof. The author proof (753-771) is a genuine double induction: first it removes all cuts of maximal rank by induction on their number, replacing a topmost maximal cut through the unit's reduction lemma and lowering the count, then it removes all ranks by induction on the maximal rank itself. Managing the two nested induction hypotheses and seeing why the topmost-cut replacement strictly decreases either the rank or the count is the load-bearing work; the rank-reduction step itself is delegated to the separately proved reduction lemma of the same unit.
